item.title: Social isolation in Australia has nearly doubled over two decades
item.description: Australians are becoming increasingly lonely and socially isolated, according to new University of Sydney research that found rates of social isolation nearly doubled over the past 23 years. Loneliness rates also increased over time, though more gradually than social isolation, with the sharpest impacts observed among vulnerable populations. Fuente: Phys.org.
